entries.claim: RG115a prescribes the 21-word Father-directed conclusion and Amen (w022–w043). This formula is supplied after the proper body’s abbreviated cue, not printed continuously on the proper page. The unaccented rubric prints no comma after Christum and ends with the rubric enumeration punctuation “Amen;”. Its literal accidentals differ from the selected accented reader setting. The rule does not assign a response actor; two loci of one edition are not two independent witnesses.

entries.claim: RG115a prescribes the 21-word Father-directed conclusion and Amen (w022–w043). This formula is supplied after the proper body’s abbreviated cue, not printed continuously on the proper page. The rubric prints a comma after Christum, lowercase qui, the seven selected house stress accents and terminal “Amen;”. The selected response period is an editorial setting. The rule does not assign a response actor; two loci of one edition are not two independent witnesses.
